name: obsidian-agents
description: Launch Claude Code from your Obsidian vault

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm for this repo.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
